'''Hootlet''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Tikowl]] at 6 bronze stars/19 copies after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Hootlet believes in time magic and the tail pendulum is a most cherished treasure. Now watch and listen closely... er, was that time magic or sleep magic?"

Hootlet is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A green owl with large, yellow eyes, a white underbelly, and a golden pendulum for a tail.

Hootlet's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces its green feathers with pink.

== Evolution Trial ==
Hootlet's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Tikowl]] you need to complete the following task:
* Log in for 2 days in a row.

== Trivia ==
* Hootlet and its evolutions were added to the game on 5/12/2026 alongside [[Pandagrand]] and [[Sealord]].
